name: io.github.velsrocky/vtai-agent
description: VT-AIAgent: system-automation agent exposed as an MCP server for opencode/claude/pi. Guarded machine control — sandboxed allowlisted shell, dry-run-first file tools, backups, media transcode, disk audit, delegate coding with verify+rollback, and REA-powered static analysis (inspect_application). Every allow and deny is audited.
